title: Insha ya Wasifu (Theme 1: Nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child decides the kind of insha from what it does: tells events (masimulizi), describes (wasifu) or explains (maelezo), and finds its three parts.
representations: three short model texts, one of each kind
steps: Ask: does it tell, describe or explain?
Find the utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

board.say: Insha hii inasimulia, inaeleza au inafafanua?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts three texts into the chart and labels the parts of one.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni insha ya aina gani? "Bibi yangu ni mpole. Ana nywele nyeupe na anapenda kusimulia hadithi."" Kwa nini "masimulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wasifu humwelezea mtu au kitu: sura, tabia na maisha. Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni insha ya aina gani? "Jumamosi, Achieng alienda sokoni. Mvua ilianza kunyesha, akakimbilia dukani."" Kwa nini "wasifu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Masimulizi husimulia mambo yaliyotokea kwa mpangilio. Wasifu huelezea jinsi mtu alivyo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni insha ya aina gani? "Ili kupika wali, osha mchele kwanza. Kisha chemsha maji."" Kwa nini "masimulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu hatua kwa hatua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___." Kwa nini "utangulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ina utangulizi mwanzoni, kiini katikati na hitimisho mwishoni.

checks.question: Insha inayosimulia matukio ni ya aina gani?
Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha ni?

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya wasifu before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Nyumbani Kwetu".

misconceptions.repair: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anaona nini akisoma sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.

listen_for: Nyumba yetu ina vyumba vitatu mikubwa.
misconceptions.ask: Nomino hii iko katika ngeli gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.

listen_for: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inahusiana vipi na anwani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Nyumbani Kwetu"?
checks.answer: Nyumba yetu ina paa jekundu na madirisha manne makubwa.

checks.question: Insha ya wasifu ina sehemu zipi?
